DDInter461.mechanism: Coadministration with cedazuridine may increase the systemic exposure of drugs that are metabolized by the cytidine deaminase (CDA) enzyme.  The mechanism involves inhibition of CDA by cedazuridine.  Increased toxicity or altered efficacy of CDA substrates may result.
